spark_open.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. Its entire body except for several glossy dark structures is covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the lower legs and lighter tan on the muzzle, chest and underside. It has the proportions and head shape of a bear, standing on four thick legs with clawed paws and a very short stubby tail at the rear. On its back are two large, smooth, highly glossy dark reddish-brown domed structures resembling beetle exoskeleton, one over the shoulders and a larger oval over the mid-back to rump. A single large glossy dark curved horn with a small side prong projects from the center of its forehead between the ears, and segmented glossy plates cover the outer sides of the forelegs. A row of small circular holes rims the lower edge of the larger back shell where it meets the fur.

meta_spark.description: A large bulky four-legged creature with dense shaggy brown bear fur covering its head, torso, legs and short tail, standing in profile facing right. It has a bear head with a tan muzzle, black nose, small dark eyes and small rounded ears, but with a single long curved glossy dark beetle horn growing from its forehead. On its back are two large glossy dark reddish-brown beetle shells, one shield-like plate over the shoulders and one long elytra-like shell over the rear back, with a row of small round holes along the furry flank beneath the rear shell. The upper front legs bear patches of glossy dark segmented beetle armor, and all four feet are broad bear paws with long pale claws.
